n197193bdf7.headline: Kazakhstan eyes Pakistan ports as Hormuz crisis disrupts Iran route
n197193bdf7.summary: Shipping through the Strait of Hormuz has effectively stopped. Kazakhstan has lost a potential direct route through Iran, prompting it to look at Pakistani ports for its transport strategy.
n197193bdf7.why: Landlocked Central Asian exporters depend on alternative transit routes, so chokepoint disruptions reshape trade costs and logistics.

n3ce4b82aa4.headline: HELLENiQ ENERGY Launches Solar in Romania
n3ce4b82aa4.summary: HELLENiQ ENERGY has begun commercial operation of its first 58 MW of solar projects in Romania. The move is a step in the company's regional green energy expansion.
n3ce4b82aa4.why: HELLENiQ ENERGY is a Greek integrated energy group, and its renewables build-out shifts its earnings mix toward power generation.

n7d773828de.headline: DSE reveals women’s role in markets
n7d773828de.summary: The Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange said women hold 35.5% of investment accounts, reflecting progress in gender inclusion. The exchange said the gap with male investors remains and targeted initiatives are needed.
n7d773828de.why: Investor participation rates indicate the depth of a stock exchange's retail base, which affects market liquidity.

n8a7a49b51b.headline: Dollar Index (DXY) Hits Yearly High
n8a7a49b51b.summary: The dollar index rose above last week's peak, around the 99.68 level, setting a new high for 2026. The article cites a tense fundamental backdrop behind the move.
n8a7a49b51b.why: The dollar index tracks the US dollar against a basket of major currencies. Its moves affect global commodity prices, emerging-market debt and multinational earnings.
n8a7a49b51b.why_moved: The index rose above last week's peak, and the article links the move to a tense fundamental backdrop without specifying further drivers.

ne9ba3f6eb8.headline: Pan African Resources to acquire Emmerson in £163 million all-share deal
ne9ba3f6eb8.summary: South African gold miner Pan African Resources agreed to acquire Emmerson in a £163 million all-share deal. It will consolidate full ownership of the Tennant Creek joint venture in Australia via a court-approved scheme.
ne9ba3f6eb8.why: Pan African Resources is a gold producer listed in South Africa and London. Consolidating joint ventures can change how a miner's gold output and capital are controlled.

n7d83958872.headline: Athens Stock Exchange Plunges Amid Oil Surge
n7d83958872.summary: Greek and European markets tumbled as oil neared $120 a barrel amid Middle East tensions and inflation fears. The Athens stock exchange plunged in the sell-off.
n7d83958872.why: The Athens Stock Exchange is Greece's main equity market. Its performance reflects domestic and European sentiment toward energy costs and inflation.
n7d83958872.why_moved: Oil nearing $120 a barrel amid Middle East tensions and inflation fears pushed Greek and European markets lower.

neaf3498d8f.headline: Allied Critical Metals Further Highlights Rapid Payback, Capital Efficiency and Infrastructure from Borralha PEA
neaf3498d8f.summary: Allied Critical Metals reported an after-tax NPV of $473 million at 8% and a payback of about 2.2 years from production start. The IRR is 48.8% at US$1,000 per mtu WO3.
neaf3498d8f.why: Tungsten is a strategic metal used in industrial and defence applications. Project economics such as NPV and payback indicate whether a mine is likely to be financed and developed.

n6cdbb4c7e8.headline: Switzerland to enshrine right to use cash inconstitution
n6cdbb4c7e8.summary: Swiss voters approved on March 8 enshrining the right to use hard cash in the country's constitution. The measure is a constitutional change on payments.
n6cdbb4c7e8.why: Switzerland is a major financial centre, and rules on cash affect payment systems, banks and retail operations.

ndef6771aec.headline: Kenya will use some proceeds from pipeline IPO to expand main airport
ndef6771aec.summary: Kenya will use 15 to 20 billion shillings, up to $155 million, from its IPO of Kenya Pipeline Company shares to expand the main Nairobi airport, President William Ruto said. The government raised 106.3 billion shillings by selling a 65% stake.
ndef6771aec.why: Kenya Pipeline Company operates the country's main fuel pipeline network, and state asset sales affect public finances and infrastructure investment.

nfcb08fd505.headline: Fuel Prices Surge in Greece
nfcb08fd505.summary: Unleaded petrol in Greece nears €1.85 a litre, while diesel and heating oil prices spike amid Middle East tensions.
nfcb08fd505.why: Fuel prices affect transport costs, consumer spending and inflation, and Greece imports most of its refined fuel.

n4137ece100.headline: Public opposition grows: petition launched in Latvia against cuts to overtime pay
n4137ece100.summary: A petition has been launched on the Manabalss.lv public initiatives platform to halt proposed amendments that would cut overtime pay in Latvia.
n4137ece100.why: Changes to overtime pay rules affect labour costs for employers and take-home pay for workers.

na4fa6035d5.headline: Value of Uganda January coffee exports broadly flat amid low prices
na4fa6035d5.summary: The value of Uganda's coffee exports was broadly flat in January amid lower global prices, the agriculture ministry said. Coffee is one of the country's largest exports.
na4fa6035d5.why: Coffee is a major foreign-exchange earner for Uganda, so export values and global prices affect its currency and trade balance.

n2181f3ca58.headline: Oil Price Surge Hits Indian Stock Market Hard
n2181f3ca58.summary: The Sensex fell 1,352.74 points, or 1.71%, in Monday's session as oil prices surged amid the Iran war.
n2181f3ca58.why: The BSE Sensex is the benchmark index of 30 large companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange, a key gauge of Indian equity sentiment.
n2181f3ca58.why_moved: Oil prices surged amid the Iran war, and higher energy costs weigh on India, a major oil importer, pressuring equities.

n3e3dda254f.headline: AUD/USD and NZD/USD Struggle as Market Jitters Shake Risk Sentiment
n3e3dda254f.summary: AUD/USD failed to hold a positive zone and fell below 0.7000, while NZD/USD also moved lower and may extend losses below 0.5850.
n3e3dda254f.why: The Australian and New Zealand dollars are commodity-linked currencies that often weaken when global risk appetite falls.

n943509add0.headline: How the Iran war could help Russia
n943509add0.summary: The US and Israel continue attacks on Iran in a conflict Iranian officials say has killed more than a thousand people. The article examines how the war could help Russia.
n943509add0.why: Russia is a major oil and gas exporter, so conflict-driven energy price changes directly affect its export revenues.

n54e9c07bef.headline: Shell, BP, Ithaca and Harbour Energy boosted as oil prices surge over $100
n54e9c07bef.summary: Brent crude surged above $100 a barrel on Monday as the ongoing Middle East war pushed oil prices higher. Oil companies, including Shell, BP, Ithaca and Harbour Energy, were the only gainers on the day.
n54e9c07bef.why: Shell and BP are major integrated oil producers whose earnings track crude prices, and Brent is the main global benchmark for oil.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Middle East war disruption pushed Brent above $100 a barrel.

n54e9c07bef.why_moved: Brent crude rose above $100 as the Middle East war disrupted oil supply, lifting shares of oil producers, which were the only gainers that day.

n291f335f2f.headline: Vietnam mulls removing fuel duties as Mideast war hits supplies
n291f335f2f.summary: Vietnam is considering eliminating fuel import tariffs to curb soaring prices, as the US-Israeli conflict with Iran disrupts global oil supplies. Gasoline prices in Vietnam have risen 21 percent, with crude near $120 a barrel.
n291f335f2f.why: Import duties on fuel directly affect domestic pump prices, and Vietnam relies on imported refined products.

nb150085f28.headline: EU Pushes Greece, Cyprus on Power Interconnector
nb150085f28.summary: The European Commission is urging Greece and Cyprus to restart the stalled Great Sea Interconnector. The project is intended to boost energy security and lower electricity costs.
nb150085f28.why: Power interconnectors link national grids, allowing cross-border electricity trade that can cut prices and improve supply security.

nd2d685756e.headline: ‘Cyprus facing economic challenges from position of strength’
nd2d685756e.summary: Central Bank of Cyprus governor Christodoulos Patsalides said the country is navigating economic challenges from a position of strength, citing sound fundamentals, a solid fiscal base and a resilient banking sector.
nd2d685756e.why: The central bank sets monetary policy and supervises banks, so its assessments shape investor views of the Cypriot economy and banking sector.

n0b931b3a38.headline: Pierakakis: 2022 Energy Toolkit Ready
n0b931b3a38.summary: Finance Minister Kyriakos Pierakakis said Greece and Europe have a ready policy toolkit from 2022, to be deployed if the energy crisis worsens.
n0b931b3a38.why: Government energy support measures influence household and business costs and fiscal spending in the euro area.

n41129b9215.headline: World shares tumble as Iran war pushes crude prices over $110 a barrel
n41129b9215.summary: World shares fell on Monday, with Japan's Nikkei 225 down more than 5%, after oil prices spiked near $120 a barrel. The sell-off followed the escalation of the Iran war.
n41129b9215.why: The Nikkei 225 is Japan's benchmark stock index, and Japan imports most of its crude, so oil price spikes weigh heavily on its market.

impacts.name: Nikkei 225
impacts.why: Japan's benchmark index fell more than 5% as oil price spikes raised costs for an energy-importing economy.

n41129b9215.why_moved: The Iran war pushed crude oil above $110 a barrel, with prices spiking near $120. Higher energy costs hit investor sentiment across world equity markets.

n279a33d1a9.headline: Why China can withstand oil’s surge past $100 more easily than other countries
n279a33d1a9.summary: Oil prices climbed past $100 a barrel for the first time in four years after the Iran war. OCBC analysts said China may be less sensitive, given its large crude stockpiles and diversified energy sources.
n279a33d1a9.why: China is the world's largest crude oil importer, so its exposure to oil price swings affects global demand, refiners and commodity markets.

nc671977a9c.headline: Chart Alert: WTI Crude Oil Key Short-Term Support at $102.25 for Another 20% Rally
nc671977a9c.summary: West Texas Intermediate crude rose as much as 30% intraday to $119.54, its highest level since 2022. Concerns center on the US-Iran war disrupting energy flows through the Strait of Hormuz.
nc671977a9c.why: WTI is the US benchmark crude oil price, traded on the NYMEX in New York, and a key reference for global energy costs.

impacts.name: WTI crude oil
impacts.why: Supply fears from the Iran war and Hormuz disruption drove the intraday price surge.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

nc671977a9c.why_moved: Fears that the US-Iran war could disrupt Strait of Hormuz energy flows drove a sharp intraday surge in prices.

ne7182ae569.headline: OpenClaw craze: China’s ‘raise a lobster’ AI trend pushes cloud stock up
ne7182ae569.summary: Hundreds of thousands of Chinese users are adopting the OpenClaw autonomous AI agent for personal tasks. Chinese tech firms, including Alibaba, have seen cloud stocks rise.
ne7182ae569.why: Alibaba is a major Chinese cloud and e-commerce group, and AI adoption drives demand for cloud computing.

impacts.name: Alibaba
impacts.why: Rising AI-agent adoption drives demand for cloud services, which lifted cloud stocks.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n8fba92e7bd.headline: Mideast war sends oil prices soaring to their highest since 2022
n8fba92e7bd.summary: Oil prices briefly surged toward $120 a barrel on Monday, their highest since 2022, before easing slightly as the escalating war in Iran continued.
n8fba92e7bd.why: Brent crude is the main global oil benchmark, and sharp moves in it feed through to inflation, central bank policy, airline costs and energy equities.
n8fba92e7bd.why_moved: Oil jumped toward $120 a barrel as the war in Iran escalated, raising concerns about global energy supply.

nae0f5c849b.headline: The U.S. names its 7th dead soldier, Iran names a new supreme leader on Day 10 of war
nae0f5c849b.summary: The Pentagon said a Space Brigade sergeant was killed, and oil prices rose after Iran named Mojtaba Khamenei supreme leader and launched new attacks on Israel and Gulf states.
nae0f5c849b.why: Leadership changes and attacks in Iran and the Gulf raise supply risk for crude oil, one of the world's most traded commodities.
nae0f5c849b.why_moved: Oil prices rose after Iran named a new supreme leader and launched fresh attacks on Israel and Gulf states, raising concern about supply disruption.

n8bd019ef0d.headline: Nifty crashes 5% in just 6 sessions as Middle East war induces massive selloff. More pain or a relief rally in sight?
n8bd019ef0d.summary: The Nifty fell 5.3% in six trading sessions in March amid escalating US-Israel-Iran tensions. Crude oil surged nearly 29% in a single day, and the index broke key support at 24,050.
n8bd019ef0d.why: The Nifty 50 is the benchmark index of the National Stock Exchange of India, covering its largest listed companies. Crude oil is a major import cost for India.
n8bd019ef0d.why_moved: The Nifty fell as US-Israel-Iran tensions escalated, and crude oil surged nearly 29% in a single day, fuelling volatility in Indian equities.

nf8b94c3394.headline: 'Fear is stalking markets': ASX plunges amid Iran war
nf8b94c3394.summary: The ASX 200 has dropped almost three per cent, wiping out all of its gains for the year amid the Iran war.
nf8b94c3394.why: The S&P/ASX 200 is Australia's benchmark equity index, tracking the country's largest listed companies and a key gauge for local investors.
nf8b94c3394.why_moved: Escalating conflict involving Iran raises fears about energy supply and global risk appetite, prompting broad selling in Australian equities.

n3200c98f66.headline: When record fuel prices will hit Aussies
n3200c98f66.summary: A leading motoring organisation has warned against tapping Australia's strategic fuel reserves as consumers begin panicking about a petrol shortage and record fuel prices.
n3200c98f66.why: Australia relies heavily on imported refined fuel, so supply disruptions and price spikes quickly affect households, transport and inflation.

neb8d8795dc.headline: Reliance Industries trades higher as its FMCG arm signs MoU with Fazer
neb8d8795dc.summary: Reliance Industries traded 0.41% higher at Rs 1,410.90 on the BSE after its FMCG arm signed an MoU with Fazer.
neb8d8795dc.why: Reliance Industries is one of India's largest conglomerates, with operations spanning energy, retail and consumer goods.

impacts.name: Reliance Industries
impacts.why: The company's shares traded higher on the day after its FMCG arm signed the MoU.

n38b2981e92.headline: Stock markets tumble further as oil prices soar above 100 dollars a barrel
n38b2981e92.summary: Brent crude soared to $107 a barrel, having at one stage reached nearly $120, levels not seen since summer 2022. Stock markets tumbled further as oil prices rose.
n38b2981e92.why: Brent is the main international benchmark for crude oil, and its price affects energy costs and inflation worldwide.
n38b2981e92.why_moved: Oil prices surged on the conflict with Iran, and stock markets fell further as energy costs rose.

n791d293972.headline: All Eyes Remain on the Conflict in the Middle East
n791d293972.summary: Iran named Mojtaba Khamenei, son of the previous Ayatollah, as its new supreme leader. US comments suggest further action to reach its objectives, including seizing Iran's uranium.
n791d293972.why: Iran is a major oil producer, and leadership changes and military escalation there affect global energy markets and regional risk.

n700f9c3d64.headline: Aussies told not to panic buy fuel, food
n700f9c3d64.summary: Australians are being warned not to panic over concerns that the Iran war could pressure another household staple, as worries about fuel and food supply spread.
n700f9c3d64.why: Fuel and food prices feed directly into household inflation and therefore into central bank and retail spending decisions.

n36147a281f.headline: Georgieva Warns of Middle East Conflict Fallout
n36147a281f.summary: IMF chief Kristalina Georgieva urged global policymakers to prepare for economic disruption from the Middle East conflict. She cited oil shocks and supply chain strain.
n36147a281f.why: The International Monetary Fund monitors the global economy and advises member governments on fiscal and monetary policy. Its warnings signal how policymakers may respond to energy and trade shocks.

nb2c88a228c.headline: The U.S. names its 7th dead soldier, Iran names a new supreme leader on Day 10 of war
nb2c88a228c.summary: The Pentagon said a Space Brigade sergeant was killed as Iran named Mojtaba Khamenei supreme leader and launched new attacks on Israel and Gulf states. Oil prices rose.
nb2c88a228c.why: Iran is a major oil producer, and conflict involving it and the Gulf states is a core driver of global crude and energy-market risk.
nb2c88a228c.why_moved: Escalation involving Iran and Gulf states raises fears of supply disruption, which pushed oil prices higher.

na6d1519f4c.headline: Saudi Arabia warns Iran it will be ‘the biggest loser’ from attacks
na6d1519f4c.summary: Saudi Arabia warned Iran it will be the biggest loser from attacks, following the announcement of Mojtaba Khamenei as Iran's next ruler.
na6d1519f4c.why: Saudi Arabia is the largest oil exporter in the Gulf, so tensions with Iran directly affect oil supply risk.

n9fabb103dd.headline: What we know on the 10th day of the US and Israel’s war with Iran
n9fabb103dd.summary: A top Iranian official told CNN the government is prepared for a long war with the United States, on the day Iranians were directed to pledge allegiance to new supreme leader Mojtaba Khamenei.
n9fabb103dd.why: A prolonged conflict involving Iran could keep oil supply risks elevated, affecting energy markets and global inflation.

n7b41111cf3.headline: Saudi Arabia warns Iran it will be ‘the biggest loser’ from attacks
n7b41111cf3.summary: The warning followed the announcement of Mojtaba Khamenei as Iran's next ruler. It comes amid attacks linked to the wider regional conflict.
n7b41111cf3.why: Saudi Arabia is the world's largest oil exporter, and regional hostilities involving it can directly affect global crude supply. Its stance shapes Gulf security and energy markets.

n6cf2bea12e.headline: Oil Spill on D St: Jittery Indices Slip to 10 month Low
n6cf2bea12e.summary: India's main equity indices fell to a 10-month low on Monday as oil prices rose past $100 a barrel for the first time since 2022. Concerns over inflation and the rupee deepened.
n6cf2bea12e.why: India's benchmark indices track large listed companies on the National Stock Exchange and BSE. As a major oil importer, India is sensitive to crude prices, which affect inflation and the currency.
n6cf2bea12e.why_moved: Oil prices rose above $100 a barrel amid the West Asia conflict, raising concerns about inflation and energy costs for oil-importing India.

nb37d3fb3d0.headline: The U.S. names its 7th dead soldier, Iran names a new supreme leader on Day 10 of war
nb37d3fb3d0.summary: Iran named Mojtaba Khamenei as supreme leader, then launched new attacks on Israel and Gulf states. The Pentagon said a Space Brigade sergeant was killed, and oil prices rose.
nb37d3fb3d0.why: Iran is a major oil producer, and leadership and conflict developments there influence Middle East supply risk and global energy prices.
nb37d3fb3d0.why_moved: Iran's leadership change and new attacks on Israel and Gulf states increased Middle East supply risk, and oil prices rose.

n9294084f9f.headline: Price Controls Arrive: South Korea, Taiwan Impose Fuel Price Cap
n9294084f9f.summary: South Korea's government said it would swiftly implement a maximum price system on petroleum products. Taiwan is also imposing a fuel price cap.
n9294084f9f.why: Fuel price caps are government interventions that directly affect refiners' margins and domestic fuel costs.

ncd018f2d6c.headline: Japan should use nuclear plants to offset Iran crisis, opposition party head says
ncd018f2d6c.summary: Japan faces rising electricity bills from the Iran war's impact on oil and gas supplies. Opposition leader Yuichiro Tamaki advocates restarting all nuclear power plants.
ncd018f2d6c.why: Japan imports most of its fossil fuels, so energy supply shocks feed directly into electricity costs and utility policy.

ncd57f1fdeb.headline: Oil Spikes Toward $120 And Sends Global Markets Tumbling
ncd57f1fdeb.summary: Global stock markets fell as oil prices surged toward $120 per barrel. The war with Iran raised fears of inflation, supply disruptions and global economic instability.
ncd57f1fdeb.why: Crude oil is the benchmark input for fuel, transport and petrochemicals, so sharp price spikes feed into inflation and corporate costs. Equity markets tend to react quickly when energy prices jump.
ncd57f1fdeb.why_moved: Oil prices surged toward $120 per barrel amid the war with Iran, raising fears of inflation and supply disruptions. Those fears pushed global stock markets lower.

nd7fae1cf49.headline: India considers restoring Russian LNG imports as energy security concerns rise
nd7fae1cf49.summary: India is considering buying liquefied natural gas from Russia to secure energy supplies amid ongoing instability in the Middle East. The report cites AzerNEWS.
nd7fae1cf49.why: India is one of Asia's largest energy importers, so its gas sourcing decisions affect global LNG demand and prices. Russian supply has been subject to sanctions-related trade constraints.

n1046ea6335.headline: Balochistan schools, colleges shut down for two weeks amid fuel crisis
n1046ea6335.summary: Schools and colleges in Pakistan's Balochistan province have been shut for two weeks amid a fuel crisis. The education department is encouraging virtual learning.
n1046ea6335.why: Fuel shortages disrupt transport, commerce and public services, and they weigh on regional economic activity. Pakistan relies heavily on imported fuel.
